meta.method: WCAG 2.1 relative luminance, computed from the token hex values in apps/web/src/app.css; alpha utilities composited over their parent surface first.

findings.issue: The pace-trend chart encodes 'fast' sessions only with amber dots (fill-signal) against sunken. 1.85:1 in light fails the 3:1 non-text threshold and colour is the only cue; dark passes at 10.52:1.
findings.fix: Use fill-signal-ink (#8A5C12, 4.97:1 on sunken) or fill-ink with a distinct ring/shape for fast points, and add a legend so speed is not encoded by colour alone.

findings.issue: The run-modality edge stripe is 1.97:1 in light. It is redundant with the session-type text, so meaning is not lost, but the mark itself fails 3:1. Same pattern at SessionPlayer.svelte:181.
findings.fix: Use bg-signal-ink (#8A5C12, 5.30:1 on paper) for the edge in light, or keep raw signal only for purely decorative accents.

findings.issue: The today marker under the day tab is 1.85:1 in light and is aria-hidden; the tab's accessible label does not say 'today'. Sighted users rely on a low-contrast amber mark for a state cue.
findings.fix: Use bg-signal-ink (4.97:1 on sunken) and add 'today' to the tab's aria-label or show a short text cue so the state is not colour-only.

findings.issue: The active-nav underline is 1.97:1 in light. It is redundant with text-ink and aria-current, so it is decorative reinforcement, but it still fails 3:1 as a graphical mark.
findings.fix: Use bg-signal-ink (5.30:1) or accept it as decoration only and keep the aria-current/text cue as the primary indicator.

findings.issue: The selected goal option uses border-signal plus a wash fill. The border is 1.80:1 and the wash differs from paper by only 1.09:1, so the selected state is nearly invisible in light. Dark wash vs paper is 1.37:1 and the border 7.40:1.
findings.fix: Use border-signal-ink (#8A5C12, 4.85:1 on wash) or border-ink for the selected option, and strengthen the wash or add a checkmark so selection does not depend on a faint fill.

findings.issue: The active-session card outline composites to 1.40:1 in light (3.37:1 dark). The outline is the only card-level cue that the session is active, and it fails 3:1.
findings.fix: Use border-signal-ink (5.30:1) or border-ink for the active outline, or add a non-colour cue such as a thicker outline or label.

findings.issue: The 'planned' volume tick uses hairline-strong on sunken at 2.91:1 in light, just under 3:1. It carries planned-vs-actual meaning in the chart; dark passes at 4.10:1.
findings.fix: Use border-steel (#5A6473, 5.13:1 on sunken) or border-ink at reduced weight for the planned tick; keep hairline-strong for dividers only.

findings.issue: Empty-state ticks encode 'not logged' (copy at progress:77 says grey means not logged) but composite to 1.46:1 light / 1.61:1 dark; bg-hairline empty ticks are 1.20:1 light / 1.44:1 dark. Same pattern at progress:115, +page.svelte:184, IntensityLadder.svelte:21. Filled ticks are ink (14.62:1), so only the empty state is lost.
findings.fix: Use bg-ink/50 in light (3.18:1) and bg-paper/50 in dark (4.61:1) for empty ticks, or bg-steel solid (5.13:1 light / 7.34:1 dark); keep filled ticks ink.

findings.issue: Interactive controls whose only boundary is border-hairline (about 54 uses, e.g. Peek, Today, Log, close buttons) sit at 1.28:1 light / 1.38:1 dark. A hairline boundary is fine for dividers but fails 3:1 when it identifies a control.
findings.fix: Use border-hairline-strong for interactive controls (3.11:1 light / 3.95:1 dark) and keep border-hairline for non-interactive dividers.

findings.issue: The stale-plan banner border is 1.97:1 in light. The banner also has text and a wash fill, so the border is not the only cue, but it fails 3:1 as a graphical mark.
findings.fix: Use border-signal-ink (5.30:1 on paper) if the border must carry the alert, or keep raw signal as decoration only.

summary: No WCAG AA text failures: steel on paper 5.47/7.07, steel on sunken 5.13/7.34, signal-ink on paper 5.30/10.12, all pass in both themes. No bare text-signal is used; text-signal-ink is used throughout. Failures are light-theme non-text marks: raw signal 1.97 on paper and 1.85 on sunken (dark passes at 10.12), empty-state ticks 1.20-1.49, planned tick 2.91, and hairline control borders 1.28. Fixes: use signal-ink for meaningful amber marks, ink/50 or steel for empty ticks, hairline-strong for control borders.
